text:
I'm terrified of pain!!
I've had tartar removed here twice by a male dentist,
recommended by my mother because she's been getting oral care at this clinic since before I was born.

I trusted the dentists here so much that I decided to have a tooth extracted following her recommendation. This time, I had it done by a female dentist. I told the assistant that I was afraid of pain and asked her to apply a numbing cream before the actual anesthetic injection. The dentist was very gentle, polite, and it didn't hurt at all. It was a great experience for my first tooth extraction here. The price was fair. This is a heartfelt review. Thank you so much for the excellent treatment at this clinic. ☺️☺️☺️
